sentences: A scholarship is financial help (money) given to someone who wants to study.
Scholarships can be given by schools or by universities or colleges or any other institution where people can study or where research needs to be done.
It is similar to a bursary.
There are very many kinds of scholarships.
Some scholarships will cover all the tuition fees (money that the student needs to pay to study), others may just help towards the tuition fees.
Some scholarships may include money for other things such as food and accommodation.
Sometimes the students are expected to do something in return for having a scholarship.
They may, for example, be expected to do some particular work after they finish their studies, or they may need to help the institution in some way.
Quite often the amount of money a student gets will depend on how much money the family has.
Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women says that scholarship must be equally given for girls without discrimination.

title_en: Massachusetts State Police Marine Unit pull body from the Charles River in Boston
sentences: Thursday, March 21, 2024 A body was pulled out of the Charles River near the Massachusetts Avenue bridge in Boston, Massachusetts on Tuesday.
Massachusetts State Police Marine Unit and Dive Team spokesman Dave Procopio said the body was found by a dog walker at around 8:30 AM near the river east of the Mass Ave Bridge.
The identity of the person has not been released as of yet.
“We have nothing further we can release right now,” the spokesperson said.
The body was determined to be of an 80 year old male from Newton, Massachusetts.
No foul play is suspected in this case, according to police authorities, learned via a press release on Wednesday.
The name of the man has not been released yet by police.
EMS said the man was dead after State Police moved his body onto the shore.
Dedication can mean: the act of consecrating (making holy) a religious building such as a temple or church.
Dedication can also mean the writing at the beginning of a book or piece of music in which the author or composer says that it was written for a particular person.
For example: a composer may write a piece of music for a particular musician and dedicate it to them.
An author may dedicate a book to someone they love or respect.
A book or a piece of music may be dedicated to the person who has paid them to write it.
This may be a rich person such as king.

title_en: United States, Maryland: Baltimore Police Department detective hospitalized
sentences: Thursday, December 25, 2025 A Baltimore Police Department detective was hospitalized on Monday evening in the neighborhood of Mid-Govans located in North Baltimore, Maryland, United States.
The officer was in stable condition after being hit by a police car at around 5:30 p.m. EST (2230 UTC) during a foot chase of a suspect in block 5600 of York Road.
Police noted the crash was by accident.
The detective has been released from the hospital by Tuesday.
Maryland borders Virginia to its south, West Virginia to the west, Pennsylvania to the north, and Delaware to its east, and the national capital Washington, D.C. district to the southwest.
Data management is the practice of collecting and using data as effectively as possible.
It is sometimes called information management or knowledge management.
Data management makes information useful by organizing it and making it easy to access.
It is important to manage data correctly, or it might be lost or accidentally deleted by scientists trying to use the data.
Usually, data is stored in central collections (called "warehouses") for management.
Data management applications make it possible to search for specific data in these collections.

title_en: Bargi plant in central Italy felt with explosion
sentences: Monday, April 15, 2024 A hydroelectric powerplant located on Lake Suviana in central Italy was hit with an explosion last week.
At least three people were killed and four other bodies are missing, said Marco Masinara, the mayor of the near town of Camugnano.
Three others were hurt badly and were taken to hospital.
Lake Suviana is located between Bologna and Florence.
The dam works under the energy company, Enel Green Power.
A fire started on one of the transformers in the early afternoon.
No cause for the explosion has been determined.

title_en: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999
sentences: The Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999 (Cth) is a law made by the Australian Parliament.
It helps protect Australia’s environment, including its plants, animals, and important natural and cultural places.
The law started on 16 July 2000.
It created rules to help protect and bring back endangered species and special natural areas so they do not get worse.
As of September 2024, the Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water takes care of this law.
Lists of endangered species are made under this law.
These lists are the main source of information about threatened species in Australia and can be found online in the Species Profile and Threats Database (SPRAT).
This law is based on the powers given to the Australian Parliament by the Australian Constitution.
Many important parts of the law come from international agreements with other countries.
However, several reviews and checks have shown that the law has many problems and does not protect the environment well enough.

title_en: The Ancient Pyramids of the World, a new photo exhibition by Viktor Pinchuk took place in Crimea
sentences: Tuesday, June 4, 2024 Yesterday, Russian Wikinews attended one of the latest cultural events in Crimea.
An exhibition of works by Russian photographer Viktor Pinchuk was held at the Genoese Fortress Museum-Reserve in Sudak.
It was timed to coincide with the annual "Night of Geography" event of the Russian Geographical Society.
The exhibition was held in a digital format, which allowed an increase in the number of works on display, without transporting them to the exhibition.
The author, who traveled to dozens of countries in Africa, Asia, Oceania and Latin America, presented to the audience a collection of photographs taken at different times, all united by one theme.
The exhibition is called The Ancient Pyramids of the World ((ru))Russian language: Древнейшие пирамиды мира.

It contains images of archaeological monuments from Egypt, Sudan, Mexico, Guatemala, El Salvador, Indonesia, Cambodia, Samoa and Peru — although the objects called "pyramids" in Túcume are of controversial origin).
The author highlighted the once pyramid-shaped and now almost completely destroyed Pulemelei Mound.
It is located in the impenetrable jungle of the Samoan island of Savai'i.
It was visited by the Crimean wanderer, and is practically unknown outside a narrow circle of professional archaeologists.
The "road" to it is so overgrown that it is impossible to get there without a guide.

What visitors learned, according to the author of the exhibition, should encourage them to hit the road, or at least, pay more attention to the study of the historical and geographical objects of the planet.
